reason: The README describes a web chat navigation rail for locating questions, tracking scroll position, preloading history, and maintaining session titles, so navigation-panels is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 对话界面添加提问导航轨，支持问题定位、滚动跟随、历史预加载和会话标题管理。
summaries.en: Adds a question navigation rail to the DSH Web chat interface with scrolling, history preloading, and session title management.

capabilities: Adds a left-side navigation rail to the web chat interface
Reads conversation history and extracts user-question summaries
Provides click-to-scroll navigation with scroll tracking and background history loading
Stores manually assigned or generated session titles locally
